text: Layout. I like the layout of the old app better, easier to scroll and see my balances. Within the new app, everything looks so bleak and white, which does not make it as easy to visually find what you need, you gotta scan and look for it. The view your balances can’t be viewed as individual accounts as well, it’s either you want to see them all, or cannot see any of them at all.
UI and Necessity of new app?. I prefer the old UI and I do not understand why there needs to be a new app instead of just updating the old one
Hold off. The updated app is dreadful, noisy interface that is way too cluttered. Old app was lean and easy to use.  Bad move ING

NEW! Ads all over your banking app! …. You guys are seriously having us on if you’re gonna move us to a new app, and then shove ads all over the main page. 

I use this app to do my banking, not to be marketed to. 

3 Ads alone JUST on the balance screen. get real. i understand i can say “im not interested” but seriously cut it out. i shouldn’t have to do that 3 x when i open the app. 

Also I would presume you have a responsibility as a financial provider to not try and blast credit cards and insurance to customers, particularly vulnerable ones.

This is good. I downloaded the app and it does everything I need for a banking app for my three ING accounts. It’s functional and the UI is refreshed. It’s better than some of the other banking apps (hey ANZ 👋). Nice work team!

Old App is much clearer. New app is has an overly cluttered messy transaction layout with too many elements but no running balance total with each transaction. Basically more unnecessary junk but somehow less of what I actually need. Also have to toggle back to starting page to see other account which is a step down from the old version where you can just scroll left and right for other accounts. Bring back the old app. This one is a downgrade.

Terrible. Opened the app and immediately deleted it when it wanted me to set a 5 digit pin. Was the UX team asleep when this decision was made? Not only is this pointless when my access code is limited 4 digits, but if you want me to use more than 4 digits why arbitrarily limit it to 5?
Can’t manage multiple accounts anymore. The old app was so much more functional, especially for managing multiple accounts. So frustrating to have it go backwards like this.

Hiding Accounts from Home Screen then you can’t transfer to them. When you hide the account from the home screen you can’t transfer to it, so you need to make it visible, transfer, then hide it again. Really bad
A bit rubbish. I can no longer see my transaction descriptions without clicking on each transaction. Not helpful

Horrible UX/UI. This app needs a full user experience overhaul and redesign. There’s so many modern banking apps that they could have used as some inspiration, instead we have this amateur hour app. Everything from the font, to infographics, to icons looks cheap. I much preferred the previous apps experience where you could see how much was in your account in large type FIRST. This app the hierarchy is a mess, the journey is unintuitive and the design is ugly. I’d happily redesign this for free and if you use it then you could pay me, that’s how desperate I am for this to be fixed.

Get a new product manager. Whoever ok’d this replacement app needs to be fired.
Old was gold, this new one sucks
Features. Feels like this version has less features compared to the older app.

Prefer Old App. I don’t like the new app, I wasn’t able to transfer between accounts it kept failing which made me wonder if this was a scam app, and the look was very confusing and not user friendly.  please stay with the old app
Horrible UX. The look and feel of the new app is horrible. A big step backwards. The old app was ok but this is a huge regression. Some major upgrades are needed ASAP.

Disappointing. After waiting all this time for a new app, I feel let down. Sure, it has notifications but is that really something to praise in 2026? The old app had personality and did everything you needed. The new one is beige, just like any other bank which is not what I used to like about ING. Hope a rethink is on the cards.

Bring back running transaction balances.. I am really frustrated with the new app, which is surely meant to make things easier for customers. For me, you’ve made operating the Savings Maximiser account on the app impossible, BY NO LONGER SHOWING THE RUNNING BALANCE AGAINST EACH TRANSACTION.

The app shows you are well aware of what you’ve done, telling customers to go to the website instead. 
You also know that the Savings Maximiser balance at the end of the previous month will determine whether the bonus is paid the following month. So you’ve probably done this quite deliberately, in an effort to stop customers using the Savings Maximiser to its fullest.

What was a really good app has failed. And badly.

App is horrible. I want the running balance next to my transactions like the old app had. 

Whoever got rid of it should never work in finance or UI ever again.

Terrible. Adding a new payee forces you to verify the details, details verified and show as verified and identical to what I have entered.. but no option to save the save the details ..only options are Back or Cancel … so I log out and back in, enter the exact same details as I did previously it now says NOT verified but gives the option to save it and sends an sms to save the new payee … utterly ridiculous and the new app totally sucks..then if you have the app on your phone, laptop and iPad, you need three different log in PIN numbers …
In what world do the idiots who created this app see it as an improvement ..
Account names. Account names on the browser don’t show on the app. Frustrating - please fix

Unnecessary. Half the reason I stuck with ING is because the app was so good to use. I can’t swipe between my accounts and now have to click back and then click in. It feels completely unnecessary - who asked for this??
Terrible experience. Forced to update and what a terrible app, slow.. UI is not good and unable to view balance without logging in. Whoever decided this app would be an improvement should be fired
Slow slow slow. Slow to log in, slow to make transfers. It’s 2 steps backwards

Why change?? This is terrible. The functionality and aesthetic of this new app is such a downgrade from the previous one. I’m baffled anyone thought this app was a good move. Anything good about ING is being removed piece by piece, honestly might just change banks after being forced to use this horrible app.

Disappointing. Multiple user profiles on one device are not supported on the new app - something that was not clearly communicated prior to installation and setup of the new app. (Old app did support multiple profiles)
Once you set up the first profile your device is locked to this profile - apparently you can’t even delete the app the set up a new profile.
AI Garbage. Forced AI chat feature and face scanning required to login into the app. Typical trash. Disgusting

Less functionality and poor security. This new improved app has less functionality than the old one. And the security is woeful - in the age of fraud, this app is secured by a four-digit passcode only! Using the client number that is printed on all documentation including the card. What could go wrong!
Not a fan. Maybe if they could merge the style of the old app with the new one I’d like it more lol. I find the white harsh to look at
It’s fine, I guess?. Why change?? The old app was perfect, simple, easy to look at - this new one is so hard to look through!

Accessibility. There has been major regression in accessibility for people using this app with a screen reader. I have lodged a complaint and pointed out the accessibility regressions in this app. These issues have still not been fixed. Hopefully they will be fixed soon.

Less functionality. Much less functionality than the previous app. The previous app was pretty awesome. Poor UX on this one. I miss seeing the balance changes as you spend. Overall less useful and more annoying. Please get the old app features on this one

Oh this thing stinks!!!. Now the second time i have been locked out of banking because the app says i have tried 3 times with i correct pin when all i have done is pick up my phone and press the app button. So close to changing banks over this new app

Two stars is being nice. Who will approve this junk?. Had a company agreed to pay money to have an app developed. It’s worse than the old one and how the companies who developed the apps in good conscience develop an app that is so bad. It doesn’t even pull over basic information like the naming of accounts you can rename an account in the old app online. It has a name in the new app no sorry no name. So if I rename it in the new app, is that gonna rename it everywhere or just in the new app the inconsistency is astonishing. Being at balances before you actually log into the app one of the best features, gone. Oh with a new app you’re expecting a widget no sorry still not available. What about features that were not on the old app that you had to go to the website to do? Don’t worry we’ve got a button in the app which will take you to the website, so you still can’t do it in the app. I hate to think how much money they spent developing this rubbish.

Oh, and let me guess on the website. My bank account still has a four digit number as it’s password such an extreme level of security, not.

Why ignore your customers feedback?. New app is terrible. Clunky interface and very difficult to use. The old app was perfect, and all your customers seem to be providing the same feedback, so why ignore this feedback? I thought you were a bank for the people.. not like other banks who force changes with no regard for users, guess you’re all the same. It’s a shame

BRING BACK THE OLD APP!. The new app has been designed terribly!
I have multiple sub-accounts that I’ve now lost the names to, and have to try and figure out which one’s which. 
The transaction details are useless for anyone that’s trying to follow a budget. Absolutely HATE the new app and am furious I’ve been forced to use it. Will genuinely consider moving banks, so I can track my budget more than what this new app allows.
Disappointing wxperience. This is a giant step backwards compared ro the previous app. Both in functionality and design.

Just poorly designed. Why don’t my account names transfer across? They show on desktop and the old app. Why don’t all my accounts show when transferring funds? They do on desktop and the old app. Why do I have to have the accounts grouped by account type instead of the order I previously had them in with the old app? Why do I need multiple pages of other products for ING to advertise at me? This app is so bad our whole family is switching to Bank Australia because that is less of a pain than dealing with this app.

Update: We did actually switch banks and closed our ING accounts. No regrets.
?. are you happy with this? i don’t want to be mean, but please hire a product designer for the mobile app.

Please don’t make us use this. The current App is far easier to view quick balances, see transactions listed, all accounts listed etc. Cannot understand why this has all been changed so much and pushed to a new App with no benefit to users that I can see. Would rather not have to use this please!

Disappointed bring back old app!!. Why are ING changing the app so often. I really preferred the basic, functional look and operation of the original app. This new one is too busy and the info I want to view now takes longer to find. Disappointed!
Nothing is 5 digits. Why force people to use a 5 digit pin?! Bizarre decisions, just like forcing us all onto a new app.

Worst Update. Why the team at ING thought it was a good idea to remove so many useful features, I have no clue. The app has become clunky, you can no longer swipe between bank accounts, and I am seriously considering changing bank because of this forced update

A backward step. For more than a decade, the app was my only interaction with ING. They then forced me and my elderly parent over onto this replacement app. She uses large fonts on her iPhone, which is incompatible with this app’s ability to show the transaction history. Add accessibility to the many missing features that your customers lost from the old app.
App icon. Please remove the “NEW” green banner from the app icon it’s so ugly on my home screen
Terrible. Cannot switch between joint account and personal account, have to use the app for one and browser for another, incredibly annoying and frustrating. There was nothing wrong with the old app!
Cannot complete onboarding. I get directed to online banking before SMS verification but still can’t progress through the onboarding in the app. Stuck redirecting to online banking.

New app is awful. What was wrong with the old app interface? This is like web banking not an app. This is the straw that broke the camels back for me after all the outages… I’m off to UP bank. Terrible.

Doesn’t work on older iPhones. Not all of us have the latest iPhones! You’re essentially cutting off support for customers that have no issues with the legacy app in its current form. I will soon have to resort to using Internet Banking via the Safari browser. Pathetic! Stupid bank! It’s also a good opportunity to shop around for a bank that still supports order iPhones!!

Downgrade. Don’t phase out the old version while it doesn’t have full feature parity. You can see that everyone WANTS things like running balances, etc. You guys need to push back on whatever your PMs are smoking.
A step backward. Why create a new app when the old one worked perfectly. This is a step backwards. I will continue to use the old app and hope the don’t retire it for this terrible “upgrade”.

No accumulative balances. The old app had more functionality and a running balance total against each transaction. The new app does not have that function, therefore cannot tell what the balance of the account is on any given day or end of mayor after a certain transaction. An upgrade should keep at least the basic functions of the previous app. Very disappointed.
:(. If it ain’t broke don’t “fix” it. Absolutely horrendous UX. Please bring back the old app!!

New ING App Horrid. Absolute junk of an app. The old app was way better especially with the UI. I just changed banks to Macquarie after years of banking with ING. The Macquarie app is way better and more functional and this was one of the reasons I switched banks. 

Bye ING - you used to be good but you went all downhill over the past two years and I bit the bullet and had enough.
layout.. i want the account display back on the login page.  i don't like the layout of this new page where it's confusing to read all my accounts.

Hate it so much!. This app is awful. So sick of it being pushed and the former one being shut down. Shows enormous disdain for ING’s customers that they are ignoring all the feedback and going ahead with this rollout anyway. Time to change banks

Why?. Why did you go from an award winning app to this?

If it’s backend functionality then you should have just added that in to the old one.

This one is painful to use by comparison, it’s like I’m going back to 2007 before mobile internet took off and you still needed a PC to do meaningful things online.
No running balance, no transaction description on the face of online banking or on the statement.. It would be horrible idea to move to this new app before fixing these issues. I will be moving.

Liking it so far. I like how the new app is designed, it’s much easier to see where everything is and to also see the transactions highlighted. Looking forward to seeing how the rest of the functions roll out eventually.

I think it’s great. I don’t understand why this app has such a low rating. Logging in with biometrics is quick and always works. Logout is also quick and easy to access, unlike many apps that require several clicks. I can see a summary of my account balances straight away and making payments and transfers is super easy and clear. I think there is also an option to see balances without logging in, which some folks might be missing. All in all I never have any problems with it and it is one of the smoothest apps I have.

Changed banks. After patiently waiting over the past year for the updates to include the changes we are asking for, I have left ING for an Aussie bank that offers everything and also much better interest rates.
I would’ve stayed if ING had shown they cared, because it was a good bank once.

they r discontinuing the old app? why?. this is worse
theres no running total of your account balance? theres no viewing balance before logging in??

New app is a downgrade from old app. Firstly, really frustrating having to recreate the account nicknames in the new app. ING  already has my preferred account nicknames for the relevant accounts, as set up on internet banking and just appeared automatically in the old app. Now to have to recreate them, and then not be able to copy them all exactly (due to an arbitrary 40 character limit) now means I have 2 sets of nicknames for my accounts across the internet banking platform and the new app. So do I now have to update them twice when I change the nickname? We should be able to update the nickname and it replicate across all platforms, so this is very frustrating having to do things multiple times.

Secondly, not having a running balance is annoying, and having to click into each transaction to see details seems another huge step backwards compared to what we had in the old app.

Thirdly, having the accounts categorised as Orange Everyday, and Savings Maximisers etc but then having those titles for each account seems bizarre. Again, the previous app look and feel was a country mile better.

In this day and age, to have the app be downgraded like it has been is really disappointing. If it doesn’t improve (revert back to old app) I will probably be looking to take my banking elsewhere. Not at all what I expected from ING, as you are usually quite ahead of the game. Not with this app, unfortunately.

Can’t differentiate between accounts. I cannot change account names in the new app. I have more than one orange every day and more than one savings maximiser so I can’t differentiate between them now. Not happy.
Have not tried too much else yet.
Horrible. How is this app allowed to be released when it’s so bad? Cant put in two accounts. Slow, ugly. Wow. Do better.

Why fix something that ain’t broke?. As this app is specific to ING customers, please listen to us.  The old app is fine, easier to use and superior to this one?  Why, why are you making us use this without having the basic functionality as the previous? Let our accounts be hidden from sight & let us customise our views. 

You’ve had this app open to a few for a while and no one has given it more than one star..  just saying

Someone needs to be held accountable for this.. or hire a project manager who can fix this mess

Terrible app. I was really hoping that the app would have improved before the old one was phased out. It is hard to believe that this is the best that they could come up with. It is hands down the worst banking app I have come across. I am considering moving back to my old bank to avoid dealing with it.

Older app is way more functional. The first time I’ve been inspired to ever write an app review - this new app sucks compared to the older version. It’s clunky - less functional. Please revert back to

Worthless junk. I do not understand how they have made such a bad at when the other one is 1 million times better and it’s probably the best banking app I’ve used. I’m not gonna call the bank and ask them to put my other accounts onto the app. Please stop the madness. Take the loss admit you messed up and leave the old one.
No dark mode?. Boring looking app with no dark mode
Balance view?. Seems okay but not being able to see your balance on screen sucks, now we have to login to see the balance? Not good at all

A Step Backwards. >> Latest app update as at Oct 14 2026 this issue still hasn’t been addressed. <<

Transaction items on the main list screen for each account don’t display the description. Any transfers between accounts within the app simply say “Transfer to (account name)” or “Transfer from (account name)”. 

There is no way to rapidly visually reconcile a transfer without tapping through to its full detail. 

Just as frustrating, this lack of useful information extends to transfers from other banks. If, like me, you routinely transfer from another bank into your ING account, the basic info on the transaction list is “(Name of the person who transferred to you)”. Endless entries with “(Name of the person who transferred to you)”

>>> The description of the transfer should be included in the default list display, as well as the destination or origin. This is present in the old ING app, and should be here too. <<<

Until this is addressed, the only way I’ll leave the old ING app behind is when they shut it down completely.

I CHANGED BANK BECAUSE OF THIS APP (after 10 years with ING). CASE STUDY IN ARROGANCE AND INEPTITUDE. 


ING what an absolute disaster. The arrogance of whoever was in charge of this forced migration needs to be a case study in how to lose loyal customers. This app is like something out of the early 2000s. It’s ugly, clunky and the worst part? It wasn’t even needed. 

The old app was the gold standard of banking apps. 

This isn’t even a polished turd.

After 10 years as a loyal ING customer, it’s sad that it came to this.

You need to sack whoever the product manager is.
App crashes on iPad during setup. Crashes on last step of setup. I gave up after 2 attempts. I wonder if security testing is any better than than app testing!!
Worst “upgrade”. Not intuitive. UI isn’t as nice. Navigation isn’t as clear. Requires a 5 digit pin which is so odd.

Not an upgrade. This app is a serious downgrade on the original app. I have recently opened a secondary everyday account and while the account is active on the website, when I’m in the app it is pending and I can’t even use it. 

Also the nicknames of accounts aren’t visible making it extremely difficult to locate what savings acc is what. 

This app needs serious improvements.
Old app better. The old app works better and is more intuitive.
Pointless downgrade. App is worse than the previous one. Why overhaul something that was good and everyone was used to?
I miss emojis. The new app is fine. It is simple for what I need. But I’m disappointed you’ve taken away the option to use emojis in the account names. Please bring it back!
Can’t use. I can’t enter a decimal point (.) when typing an amount, so I can’t use the app.
Awful app to sign up on no help. Awful

New app SUCKS. yeah this new app is horrible. I’m going to pretend to be an ING exec who greenlit this. “Hi, I have no brain and have a personal peasant manage my account so I have not the faintest clue of an idea of how an app should function. Let me jsut get the current app, make it dogshìť, and remove all of the good features that ING Aus customers liked. Let me also add a subscription services since I’m an idiot.” There we go, pretty accurate I’d say.

Terrible app. This upgrade is hopeless. I’m tempted to change banks. I emailed and heard a “thanks for your message email” but no evidence of listening to the feedback. Names of accounts don’t appear once you select “transfer between accounts”. Everyday savers and high interest are permanently separated I no the Home Screen rather being able to be customary reordered. To hide a balance requires mavigatinn many pages and then back again to home just to check the balance of an account only then navigate back out to hide it again if that’s how you prefer it 99% of the time. 
To navigate pages you have to click exit at the top of the screen rather than simply swipe back. 
Colour scheme is bland and less clear. 

What is the benefit of the new app? It’s the number of this inconveniences that just makes the whole app seem underdeveloped and under considered.

Bring back the old app. The latest update is a step backwards. When viewing past transactions in savings account, you can no longer see what the total balance was at the time- a basic but important feature that should not have been removed.

Payments that have been made into account also now read as ‘direct credit’ and require you to click on each individual payment for more details. Very disappointing from ING, there was nothing wrong with the old app.
Very Good. Works for me very well, just as good as the old app .

No second account. Requests to bring back the ability to add a second profile to the app over the past few months have clearly fallen on deaf ears. I am currently in the process of switching banks as a direct result of this and suggest that others who are affected by this inferior new app do the same.
Less features, why?. New app lacks balance after each transaction, lacks specific date statements, lacks message inbox.

Tweaks Needed. It’s not that the new app isn’t functional but in a classic case of fixing something that wasn’t broken many things have been moved or in some cases removed altogether. The main one I miss is the running balance after each transaction, it was so much easier to keep track of ins and outs. Also the settings that used to sit on the left of screen for easy access are now buried elsewhere.
Terrible. New app is terrible. Only showing 3 of my 8 accounts, doesn’t show the different names of my savings maximizer accounts. Was nothing wrong with the old one

App is a downgrade. The “new” app is terrible and certainly not an improvement. It is where near as clean as the legacy app it replaces. The worst part is that you can no longer see your running account balance.

Ugh. Please don’t delete the old app. The new one is awful, for all the reasons stated by many others. If I’m forced to use this dreadful new app, I’ll just change bank. Please listen to your customers.

Not too bad. The app itself is not too bad once you get used to it, but it really infuriates me when I want to access my bank accounts or do my banking quickly and there is an advertisement in the way. Regardless if I hit the ‘not interested’ option, it reappears. 

Can you please either get rid of the ads or move them to the products section where they would be useful, it’s getting a bit frustrating that I can’t even do my banking without having ads shoved in my face the second my app opens.

Worst App Ever!. Feedback on the new App. I absolutely hate it. It has nowhere near the features and benefits of the existing app. You have taken something that was working beautifully and completely ruined it. The new app is so difficult to navigate and does not support multi user and multiple accounts in a user friendly format. What a waste. It is so dreadful that I am considering looking at other banks with better apps. Also, everyone in my family (10 or so people), all have ING bank accounts and feel the exact same way about the new app. We are all clinging on and using the old app until it kicks us off. ING do better.

Someone stuffed up w this one.. Download the app and suddenly all your account names are changed and you can’t change them back…? 
Called customer service - their response… try delete the app and download it again. 
My advice. Stick to the old one. Who brands the app icon w new? Just make it seamless and continue w a good service
Worst app. It’s pretty hard to completely revamp an app and only to make it hundred times worse than the old one.  Congratulations ING on this extraordinary achievement.

Some features don’t work. Some features don’t work when on a VPN which is a worry because it means overseas access is at risk.

But I shouldn’t need to be testing your app!

Finally switched banks. I've had enough of this new app. It's full of ads, riddled with bugs and the overall experience is poor. After putting up with it for a while, I asked myself why I was still suffering, so I moved to another bank.

Switching was easier than I expected. Updating direct debits and setting up Apple Pay took a few phone calls and some admin, but nothing major. I'll keep my ING accounts open for now and close them one by one.

If ING fixes the app, great, but I'm not waiting around or coming back.
Own goal. What a mess

Why it’s so hard to use!. Worst banking app ever, it doesn’t allow you to look for credit cards details and you can’t lock or pay your statement directly. The most stupid design! iNG bank you need to listen to your customers and stop shutting down the old APP!!!

App sucks. It rarely works. It produced an error when attempting activate a CC. It won’t let me change the “nickname” of the account. I had to go back to the old app.
Just because you can update something doesn’t mean you are upgrading it.

Less information?. I never write bad reviews but this is a step backwards from the old app. The running balance is gone. Please at least give us the option to turn it back on. Some pending transactions now have no description until I click for details. My accounts are now at the bottom of the page on the home screen. 
Don't you understand the most important thing for banking customers is up-front information? 
I'll be sticking with the old app until the last minute.

Old app better. The old app is much more user friendly. I have accounts with 2 other different banks and the new ING app is now the worst app out of the three. It makes me wonder if I’ll stay with them. The old app was simple to use. This one is confusing.
Search doesn’t work. There is always an error when I try to search through my transactions, which is a pretty important function that I need
Forced app update!. 2nd forced update this year. Trying to run a small business is very difficult & frustrating with ING. Great bank when we started but things are starting to slip & its noticeable.
Old very out dated. Cant change the name of the account from this app.

The new app isn’t good. The cleanliness of the ING app is kind of what kept me wanting to use ING despite worse interest rates. 

Now we have this “new and improved” experience which is slathered in ads and stuff that I don’t want on my accounts page.
Old app was better. New app looks way too busy. Old app was better. Too much detail showing when I don’t need to see it all every time.
account names. can we have our account names shown in the app?
Why. This is the only banking app that I have which requires so many updates all the friggin time. Why???
Prefer the old app. The previous app was more user intuitive. And I’m sick of always having to update the app- all these apps using up my ph storage!
Unhappy. Lost the ability to have two accounts on the new app!

ING has improved the app. There has been negative reviews before mine of bugs and issues with the app that ING have actively fixed and improved the app with that feedback. 
This app runs smoothly. It is effective for its purpose everything is laid out clearly and it’s familiar with the old app.

Absolutely awful design. This new app is awful. Where is the balance we used to get under each transaction? Now I have to make an additional screen search to go into statements to find that figure.  The type is so large I feel as though I am being shown a book for a toddler to use.  For god sake go back to the great simple CLEAR first class app design layout you had before this new app.  I will seriously consider leaving this bank as this is terrible to use.  No stars at all although I have to click one to make a comment.  I notice overall this app is getting one star so I hope management is taking note before you start losing customers.
Downgraded. The old app was nicer and easier to navigate, now I can’t find things I had no problem with before. Why change it.

This sucks. Really unimpressed with the new app. Constant need to update or you can’t use it? Rack off!! It’s like the card surcharges, they’re for the “privilege”. 
Sick of being farmed.

Nothing wrong with the old app. Simple is better 
Why change the whole app. Nothing was wrong with it.
Doesn’t copy and paste account details nicely.

It doesn’t work. Forced to ‘upgrade’ from the older app which was fine to the new app and it simply doesn’t work. Maybe my latest iOS and iPhone is ahead of the game, or maybe the IAT and quality control within ING’s IT department is not up to snuff.
can’t send exact amounts. won’t let me send cents…
Digital Billboard. Focus is clearly on stuffing the home page full of offers and not on actual banking tools people need. Terrible app.

Figured out how to change nicknames. For those having trouble changing the nickname of an account

Instead of clicking the account then clicking the Manage button (the Change name option there stupidly doesn't work) what you should do is click Home button on the bottom left then in the upper left hand corner click THAT Manage button.  Then click "Change Name, Order and Visibility"
Ads. The ads in this app are seriously annoying. An ad wedged between my balances. Ridiculous. Switching to Macquarie literally becuase of this lol

This app is costing you customers. The original app being so user friendly was one of the big appeals of banking with ING for me, still a pretty good bank overall but I’m running out of reasons to keep my accounts open here when you add in not being able to visit a physical branch as well
Bring back the old app. This new app is terrible, why fix what wasn’t broken!

New app thoughts. Hi,

Can you please add the feature like in the old app where you can copy bsb and account number at once so you don’t need to do it separately.
Same same. Don't know what people are complaining, mine works all the same as the old app. Works better better for me.

Very disappointed. I was forced to switch to the new ING app, and it’s one of the most frustrating banking app updates I’ve experienced. The previous app was simple, intuitive, and made managing my finances quick and easy. This redesign has done the exact opposite.

Previously, I had my accounts organised exactly how I wanted them, making it easy to distinguish between my everyday accounts, long-term savings, and credit card. The new app has removed that clarity, and it’s now difficult to quickly identify which account is which.

The biggest issue is the loss of easy access to my credit card. I used to be able to check my balance and transactions at a glance throughout the day, but that functionality now appears to be buried or missing altogether.

Another major frustration is that my partner and I could previously use the same phone and simply switch between our individual ING accounts. That feature has been removed, making the app far less practical for our household.

This update feels like a redesign for the sake of redesign, rather than an improvement to the user experience. Core functionality has been made more complicated, navigation is less intuitive, and tasks that were once quick now take far more effort.

I’ve banked with ING for years because of its excellent digital experience, but this update has seriously undermined that. Unless these issues are addressed, I’ll be looking at moving my banking elsewhere. I genuinely hope ING listens to the overwhelming customer feedback and prioritises usability over aesthetics.
